fixedBugs.description: TransformerSelector Lambda layer incompatibility with TensorFlow GPU serialization
fixedBugs.fix: Replaced Lambda layer with named `_PositionalEncodingLayer` subclass
fixedBugs.impact: TransformerSelector was crashing on GPU — all Transformer results pre-fix are invalid. Transformer_only single-fold re-run on cluster still pending to validate.

fixedBugs.description: MLSelector._label() all-zero bug — shift(-1) caused all labels to be zero due to lookahead
fixedBugs.fix: Removed shift(-1) — labels are now computed without lookahead
fixedBugs.impact: MLSelector results before this fix are invalid. Post-fix: MLSelector still hurts OOS (stat_ml Net SR -0.163) — it's a label mis-specification, not just a bug.

fixedBugs.description: MLSignal LabelEncoder bug causing crash on unseen labels in OOS folds
fixedBugs.impact: MLSignal now runs but is confirmed worst signal model (Net SR -0.401, OOS overfit).

fixedBugs.description: TATAMOTORS.NS had data quality issues — frequently missing bars
fixedBugs.fix: Replaced TATAMOTORS.NS with M&M.NS in the 35-stock universe
fixedBugs.impact: All results before this fix used a bad ticker. All published results (E1-E6) use the corrected universe.

fixedBugs.description: yfinance frequency string deprecation — '1H' caused FutureWarning
Incorrect SLURM partition (cn3_l40s) and missing QOS in job scripts
fixedBugs.fix: Replaced partition with 'cn3_anandi' and added '--qos=anandi' to all scripts
fixedBugs.impact: All jobs were failing to submit; now all scripts are cluster-ready.

fixedBugs.description: Floating Point Exception (SIGFPE) in RLSignal training
fixedBugs.fix: Scaled reward to percentage points and clipped to [-10, 10]; reduced n_steps (2048->512).
fixedBugs.impact: PPO agent was crashing due to exploding gradients from raw unscaled dollar rewards.

fixedBugs.description: Double-charging transaction costs on every trade
fixedBugs.fix: Modified turnover logic from `(sig_scaled != sig_prev)` to `(sig_scaled - sig_prev).abs()` and multiplied by `cost_frac / 2.0`.
fixedBugs.impact: Backtester was applying the round-trip cost on BOTH entry and exit, halving actual profitability. Fixed mathematically in JSONs.

keyDecisions.decision: Daily (1D) data only for all main experiments
keyDecisions.rationale: E1: Gross SR 1.14 (daily) vs 0.49 (hourly); hourly selects poor pairs and goes bankrupt after costs.
E2 sweep over [0,5,10,15,20,25,30,40] days — 30 days is the Pareto-optimal elbow (Net SR +0.481, cost drag 2.09pp/yr). Locked in experiments/config.py.
Diverse enough for cross-sector pairs; liquid; 561 pairs is tractable. Universe fixed before any backtest.
More data in later folds = better model quality; standard in academic finance.
Any other choice would bias the individual model comparisons.

keyDecisions.decision: OU-only as Stage 2 signal in all WFV headline experiments
keyDecisions.rationale: E3 ablation: OUThreshold Net SR +0.359 vs ensemble -0.189. MLSignal overfit, ZScore and Kalman underperform.

keyDecisions.decision: MLSelector weight = 0.0 in E7 weighted ensemble
keyDecisions.rationale: Label mis-specification confirmed across all modes — momentum label is not predictive of mean-reversion quality.

keyDecisions.decision: INR 10 lakh capital, 1 lakh per pair
keyDecisions.rationale: Realistic retail/prop desk size; avoids ADV constraints at 1L notional.
Research.md records what was found; Plan.md records what to do next. Neither is a scratch file.
Existing pairs trading literature uses US cost assumptions — inaccurate for NSE. Indian model adds STT (10bp sell-side), stamp duty, GST.
